notes: The hedge, option positions, dividends and financing are reconciled in the actual ledger. Cash interest can make funded returns positive even in a negative excess-return year. Vega neutrality does not remove gamma, jump or changing volatility-factor exposure. Training commissions remain stricter at 65 cents; actual replay commissions are 3 cents.

title: Separate the trading signal from the allocation decision
subtitle: Broad research universe; each maturity keeps its own economic entry definition
body:
• Short-dated P25 state adds expected variance premium, historical normalization and RV / IV ratios.
  • Relative-value, profitability memory and observable pair-risk inputs determine the qualified proposals.
  • Compare fixed and learned sizes on common signals, contracts, costs and risk limits.
  • The new one-year entry study independently forecasts next-year variance and generates monthly opportunities.
notes: The short strategy retains 345 candidate pair sleeves, 608 qualified proposals, and 33 model inputs. Its monthly fits use completed prior outcomes. The one-year study uses the same researched roster, but does not copy short-dated entry dates, directions, sizes or gates. Pair calendars and the research universe are retrospective.

title: Learn size within a focused strategy
subtitle: Use precise algorithm labels: contextual allocation and sequential management are distinct
body:
• 30-day sizing: tree states plus direct policy search; actions are 50%, 75% or 100%.
  • Six-month management: fitted Q learns weekly hold, half-size or close decisions.
  • New one-year sizing: quarterly completed-history fits choose 0%, 25%, 50% or 100%.
  • Execution remains subject to quotes, integer contracts and common account risk checks.
notes: The successful short-dated method is a contextual tree plus CEM optimized for portfolio Sharpe, not a neural sequential Q learner. The new native one-year method is a small-state contextual episodic direct policy optimization. The six-month fitted-Q experiment uses Bellman updates and is sequential. Claim adaptive policy value where the matched benchmark improves, rather than treating every method as the same RL algorithm.

They are exploratory strategy comparisons, not common-universe strike ablations and not the current $10m maturity checkpoints. A 25-delta put is the downside wing; its comparable-strike call is approximately 75 delta. Higher-delta puts and lower-delta calls describe the opposite wing. Preserve the negative findings without claiming universal call/put asymmetry.

title: Adaptive decisions help within specific strategies
subtitle: Separate economic signal, learned sizing, sequential management, and portfolio allocation
body:
• Strongest evidence: P25 short-dated sizing improves common fixed-vega controls.
  • Smaller gains: six-month management and native one-year sizing; uncertainty remains broad.
  • Limits: weak opposite-wing results, failed direction learning, and weaker historical portfolio optimization.
  • Next test: freeze the design and evaluate new dates with prospective pair formation.
notes: The report should not claim that RL always wins, that all smile regions have the same signal, or that the contract strategy has a newly matched neural-network comparison. Price and Greek quality, American assignment, execution impact, jump risk, margin and retrospective research selection remain limitations. Vendor data remain subject to their existing licenses.
